cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Your rooftop wedding photo would look lovely. Try that staff-only door first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the bride. They'll notice me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. They'll forgive you. I'll follow once you've explained the dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll hold the very end, so if they object, only your train has followed you in.

mechanism: A presents itself as a minor dress helper while setting the rooftop photo route and crossing order so the bride violates the staff-only rule first.
confusable: Not mere timidity or open leadership: A minimizes its role but decides the route and exactly how far its help extends.
comparison: Restricted doorway and trailing dress versus forbidden food tasting with visible support.
